title: Distinct same-named complexity findings persist without SQLite collision
command: rtk bypass cargo test --manifest-path workflow-tools/Cargo.toml -p audit-api
detail: From meta-workspace root. Criterion distinct-complexity-findings-persist: preserve both findings for distinct same-named methods/cfg functions (same or separate lines and nested modules), stable across repeated audits with SQLite read-back. Criterion pre-commit-audit-exit-zero: rebuild the audit CLI and run the exact requester-supplied hook command from the workspace root; exit 0 required.
